newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Computer failure delays Seoul index futures trade.
newsitem.headline: Computer failure delays Seoul index futures trade.

text.p: The opening of stock index futures trading in South Korea was delayed by 45 minutes on Wednesday because of a computer malfunction, the Korea Stock Exchange said.
But all trading operations were later rectified and technicians were checking the cause of the problem, an exchange spokesman said.
"All trading systems are now operating normally and trading started at 10.15 a.m. (0115 GMT) instead of the original 9.30 a.m.," the spokesman said.
He said trading will close at 3.15 p.m. (0615 GMT) as usual.
By 10.35 a.m. December futures contracts fell 0.15 points to 78.35 while the KOSPI 200 index gained 0.27 points to 77.20.
